department: Department of Computer Science (School of Engineering and Computer Science)

deadline.value: The financial-aid deadline for fall 2027 is February 15, 2027; the spring deadline is October 1.
deadline.quote: The PhD application deadlines for financial aid are February 15 for the fall semester and October 1 for the spring semester.

also.quote: Computer Science Ph.D. Fall (eligible for financial aid) - February 15

app_fee.value: The computer science application fee is $50 and cannot be waived.

fee_waiver.value: The computer science application fee cannot be waived.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are optional for PhD admission; the department encourages submitting them if you have them.
gre_general.quote: The submission of GRE scores is optional for PhD applicants, but you are highly recommended to submit the scores if you already have them.

also.quote: The submission of GRE score is optional for admission.

gre_subject.value: No subject test is mentioned for computer science.

supervisor.value: The computer science page does not say whether a faculty sponsor is needed.

funding.value: Nearly all incoming PhD students receive full tuition remission and a multi-year assistantship.
funding.quote: Nearly all incoming Ph.D. students receive full tuition remission and a multi-year research or teaching assistantship.

entry_route.value: Applicants need a bachelor's or master's in computer science or a closely related field.
entry_route.quote: All students in the Computer Science (CSI) doctoral program must have a Bachelor of Science or Master of Science degree in computer science or a closely related field.

english_waiver.value: A degree from an institution where English is the language of instruction waives the test, so an English-medium Indian degree qualifies.
english_waiver.quote: International applicants must submit their TOEFL or IELTS scores unless you have a degree from an institution where the language of instruction is English.

notes: The department's $50 fee differs from the Graduate School's $60 for international applicants; the department value is used.
name: Computer Science, Ph.D.
